headword: {頭角|とうかく}を{現|あらわ}す
gloss: to stand out; to make one's mark

definitions.gloss: to stand out; to make one's mark
definitions.explanation: For someone's talent or ability to become clearly greater than that of the people around them.

examples.japanese: ⟦めきめき→めきめき：07408_mekimeki⟧{頭角|とうかく}を{現|あらわ}す。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}→入社：03131_nyuusha⟧{二年目|にねんめ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{頭角|とうかく}を{現|あらわ}した。
examples.english: She began to stand out in her second year at the company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{頭角|とうかく}を{現|あらわ}し、⟦{二十歳|はたち}→二十歳：02933_hatachi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧になった。
examples.english: He began to stand out in high school and turned professional at twenty.

notes:
USAGE:
{頭角|とうかく} is the top of the head: the image is a head rising above the crowd. Used in praise, mostly in writing and speeches.

WATCH OUT:
Written with ⟦{現|あらわ}す→現す：02097_arawasu⟧ (to show, to appear), not ⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧ (to express).
